summary.en: The folder claims competitive selection concentrates a way of seeing, so intent alignment amplifies the dynamic, capture reaches the machine and rate must be governed; its remainder is a four-layer loop and two capture channels. The account keeps the loop's form on count models, premises open, and reads against the key step: selection on a reading falls with any cost. Six claims filed as absent are form only. No pause, floor or phenomenology; divergence on minds as root, common knowledge, measurement replacing values, generativity, impossibility.

name.en: Selection reaches cognition: winners write the rules through their lens

source.locator: Why selection reaches cognition; claims 9-10, 19, 53, 83-84

sense.en: Every social system has an internal law of whom it selects into power. A compounding competitive rule selects actors who relate instrumentally, not the wisest; they write the rules by their own way of thinking, so a way of seeing concentrates and reshapes institutions to amplify itself. This is what the folder says distinguishes it from the standard Moloch argument.

entries.quote: the system concentrates not just resources but *a way of seeing*

reading.en: Live text names the lineage: winners writing the next round's rule is capture through the rule; also forming its readers, closed capture. Two levels of one loop, on two-kind models. That readers are minds is a reading. The account diverges at the step the folder needs: a reading favouring its own kind is not selected on its own gain and falls with any cost, so something other than selection on the reading keeps the premise. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule, and where they also form its readers, closed capture'; who reads, and when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns it. 'No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no market law ranks arrangements.'

Theorem (any type): where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, courses alike in share and rule stay alike; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem (any type): the pooled rule reads the share monotonically exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'. 'The premise is moved to who reads, not removed': that actual rules are such pools is not shown.

Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's 'selecting the selectors' is the pool counted as the population is; 'That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading'. Reading [D45, later in this section]: among a kind, a favouring reading is 'not selected on its own gain and falling with any cost', so what keeps the readers' premise 'is something other than selection on the reading'.

Lead sentence: 'Selection revises its lumping. Consequences change what a formation tells apart, and acting on the new map draws on support.' Theorem (any process): every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice.

A reading just after this anchor [AI reading, D65], 'An argument, not a theorem': consequences select the organization that learns; 'gradient training, differential reproduction and institutional evaluation are different mechanisms of it'; 'unconditional convergence toward renewal of the whole is not established, and a successful proxy does not make a representation true'.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions: when the pool reads the share, when against it, when counts decide. The laws hold for any type: 'the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours'. Also that selection revises what a formation tells apart, and, argued and not a theorem, that consequences select the organization that learns.

source_adds.en: That what is selected is cognition of a kind (instrumental relating), that it is not wisdom, and that this is the law of actual societies. The models have two kinds and no minds; 'no institution is modelled on the spine'.

name.en: Another token, the same shape: the filter changes and the loop does not

source.locator: Why selection reaches cognition; claims 10-12

sense.en: Under capitalism the filter is capital-optimization ability; under totalitarian arrangements the best political fighters. The general form: a society picks one value as the token of power, the best at optimizing it gain power, and they rule by their own way of thinking. Replacing the token does not change the shape.

entries.quote: Under a totalitarian arrangement the token changes and the filter selects the best political fighters, but the shape is identical.

reading.en: The account has this as a reading of a counter-rule: a replacement read monotonically from its own share locks as the rule it replaced did, whatever it favours. It adds the limit: a counter-rule whose reading can favour the others need not lock. The worked case is the imperial examination, not capitalism or totalitarian rule. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68], no law added: a counter-rule read monotonically from its share, where every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks as the rule it replaced did; favouring only above a threshold, a change across it leaves; from a start against its reading it may never lock. The imperial examination is read as this case.
Theorem (any type): 'The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.' That actual rules read the share is the premise.

account_adds.en: A check on remedies: a remedy that is itself a selection read from its own share is the same object, under those conditions, and not otherwise.

source_adds.en: The claim about actual regimes, and that their filters do not select the moral or the perceptive.

name.en: Moloch in the mind: structural reform fails because the cognition persists

source.locator: Why selection reaches cognition; claim 54; the 2026-10-02 note on re-absorption

sense.en: The dynamic is epistemically internalized: decision-makers see through the competition lens. So structural reform alone does not change it: the cognition persists across reform attempts and rebuilds the structure that was reformed.

entries.quote: Moloch is in the mind, not only in the structure

reading.en: Re-absorption has a law: a change of the rule keeping its direction is re-read from the share at the next reading step. The same loop absorbs a change of the reading alone where that is formed from the share; a reversal held past the threshold holds. So in the model neither mind nor structure is deeper: the share carries it. One trained judge's reading turned on one note. 03's locked seeking is nearest 'in the mind', with no law. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): locked, a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; where the reading favours at every share, only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. Witness: a reversal held past the threshold is not absorbed. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

T7, conjectured for actual metrics, forbids 'a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading'. LA2, one frozen test, one trained system: one note of the loss among nine readers turned the judge, prose in all 50 picks, so it is no pool read by kind. No frozen field test of reform events.

A reading later in this section [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening: locked seeking forms when 'a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'. Diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, 'so the label cannot immunize'.

account_adds.en: That reforming the reading alone is absorbed too, only where the reading is itself formed monotonically from the share: conjectured of actual metrics, and counted against for trained judges by LA2. That a reform carrying the share across a threshold can hold.

source_adds.en: That the persistence is cognitive, in people of a selected kind, and that this is why structural reforms are re-absorbed. 03's reading of locked seeking is nearest, and it states no law of re-absorption by a mind.

name.en: The base rule: what you win compounds, so winner-takes-all is the long-run attractor

source.locator: The base rule and the attractor; claims 24, 31-32, 52, 78

sense.en: Each win is an input to the next round, so the payoff function is recursive and exponential. With scarcity and enough players, strategies converge on an attractor of narrow winning-optimization; under network effects the curve is a cliff, roughly eighty percent to first place.

entries.quote: what you have is yours and you can compound it

reading.en: No single live law states the base rule. Its pieces: counts that only grow lock a chooser, read as Arthur's increasing returns; carried amounts and transmitted shares grow exponentially on stated bounds. Convergence is scoped: below a critical mass the capacity falls; a negative market margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it. Winner takes all is one of five ends, conjectured. Winnings crossing games are open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): under a standing score a threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves; counted from the posterior instead, a score favouring the other policy lowers the first's share. Reading: 'the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989)' for a simplified model.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: at parameters with a negative margin 'a distinct protected region remains: a negative margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it.' Theorem (periphery): in the model's numbers a share of none stays none.

Open: 'Graded capacities to shape the rule, groups that form or assort by the share, a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains'; a frozen test of whether what comes back decides the direction.

Theorem (World; couplings holding at every step, bounds named): around a loop the carried amount 'is exponential both ways'; the record adds 'the pace of a selection under transmission'. 'That an actual difference grows so, that a dependence couples at every step, and that the Earth is mutually dependent are supplied.'

'[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all'; which of them the laws admit, and under which hypotheses.
Drawn one at a time, either lock is left by drift; 'a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise'.

account_adds.en: Selection does not create an absent practice, and a protected region can remain beside a degenerate one.

source_adds.en: Ownership with compounding as the generating rule; scarcity and many players as sufficient; the cliff figures; winnings that cross domains, which the account names as not yet stated.

name.en: Rationality of participation: no malice, sound local reasoning, a bad aggregate

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing, first paragraph; claims 21, 38, 83, 131

sense.en: Every move is defensible from inside ('better us than them'). Moloch does not corrupt intentions; it arranges the board so good intentions produce bad equilibria. Local reasoning is sound at every layer of a stack of games, while the composed behaviour consumes the preconditions of the composing rationality. Most people do not want this path.

entries.quote: He lives in the shape of the aggregate.

reading.en: The account's laws need no bad intent: takers each within what a step gives can together exceed it; optimizers each by their own order drain as one of their joint capacity would; two locally successful plans fail at the second joint step. The home says the first restates the commons and overshoot in near-definitional arithmetic, 'not who ought to take less'. 'Bad' is not the account's: no law says a drain is a harm. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; under the gate, enough consecutive steps of joint excess from a low enough level end every formation depending at that need.
Theorem (World): at a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity.

'no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good'; that is asked under the two premises, the continuation condition for scope and C for order. Orders, capacities and horizons are supplied.

Theorem (any process): the zipped joint plan keeps both guards where the plans are compatible. 'Two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step' (periphery, axioms reported).

account_adds.en: The exact form of the excess and its ending, and the refusal to call the aggregate bad without premises.

source_adds.en: The stack of games by layer (firms, states, cultural producers), and rationality consuming its own preconditions: legible environments, extendable trust, time to correct. The joint-plan witness has the form of local success failing when composed, not of a stack.

name.en: Perfect intent alignment does not save us

source.locator: The alignment consequence; claims 55, 81, 86, 216

sense.en: If principals are selected for instrumental cognition, an AI that does what its principal intends amplifies the dynamic and does not check it. Ren uses 'inner alignment' for the field's intent alignment. The README itself says the multipolar corollary is standard and that what is distinctive lies beneath it.

entries.quote: an AI perfectly aligned to a selfish actor can still be disastrous

reading.en: Two AI readings carry it, resting on different records and not joined. On several optimizers, the assistant adds capacity and not reading, so what neither reads falls as under one of their joint capacity. On shaping, help lowering the cost of shaping raises the rule's favour to shapers. Neither uses the source's reason, that the principal was selected, and neither needs selfishness. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: 'Alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection.' That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise. Assistance that informs the principal adds coupling, which this law does not model; it holds at a mutual best response, existence not shown.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule is read as not lowering the selection for control. Known weakness: the law is monotonicity in one parameter; the weight is carried by the empirical claim that assistance lowers the cost of shaping rules.
Theorem (World): at a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity.

account_adds.en: The exact premise, and what leaves the law: an order giving up something on the family for the condition does not rise with it.

source_adds.en: The causal reason (the principal's cognition was selected by the game), and 'amplifies' as a claim about the whole dynamic's direction, beyond one parameter's monotonicity.

name.en: Principals' ends are an output of the game, so the two alignment problems are one

source.locator: Terminology, second paragraph; Prior art

sense.en: The folder's contribution by its own statement: the standard frame takes principals' ends as given, but the base rule selects which cognition reaches the principal's seat. If so, aligning AI to its principal and fixing the game between principals are not independent problems. Offered as a conditional, a hypothesis about priority.

entries.quote: the principals' ends are an output of the game

reading.en: The account has both halves and keeps them apart. Readers are drawn from the selected, and ends enter the appraisal conditionally; but in the optimizer laws orders are supplied, and nothing selects the order the assistant serves. It also reads against a simple join: among a kind a favouring reading is not selected on its own gain, so something else, such as who holds the reading places, keeps it. Its wording stands in the dated theory map. [AI reading]

says.en: Not shown: that any actual collective, market, pool, entry rule or optimizer meets the hypotheses of a law: 'orders, capacities, horizons, pools and waiting are supplied, and the correspondence is empirical'.

Conditional (the condition for scope; C and the practical commitments for order; an argument): ends, evaluations and the rules selecting future intelligence change living too, so they enter the same appraisal; endorsement does not erase a loss.
Theorem (any type): where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. Read as minds only by a reading.

Theorem (natural-number weights; compositions of a checked law with exact criteria): a reading formation's model and valuation are state a holding formation can inform or revalue; from different starts the two routes can give the same answers and the same end state.

Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's 'selecting the selectors' is the pool counted as the population is; 'That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading'. Reading [D45, later in this section]: among a kind, a favouring reading is 'not selected on its own gain and falling with any cost', so what keeps the readers' premise 'is something other than selection on the reading'.

account_adds.en: That informing and revaluing a reader are told apart and can be observationally alike.

source_adds.en: The join: one model where the game selects the principal's order that the assistant then serves. It is the claim the README says would have to be argued against. Its wording stands only in theories/becoming/history/THEORY-MAP-2026-10-08.md.

name.en: AI strengthens the capacities competition rewards

source.locator: The alignment consequence; claims 3, 18, 82, 85

sense.en: AI is not merely additive: it strengthens what competitive systems reward, makes resources concentrate faster, and its manipulation is a step change. A sufficiently capable system crashes whichever market it enters: labour, finance, media, politics.

entries.quote: AI may make the most aggressive strategies more powerful

reading.en: One narrow form holds: help that lowers the cost of shaping raises the rule's favour to the shapers, with nothing else changed. It is monotonicity in one parameter; the weight is on an empirical claim the account leaves open and asks reviewers about. The market-crash and manipulation predictions are not taken up. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule is read as not lowering the selection for control. Known weakness: the law is monotonicity in one parameter; the weight is carried by the empirical claim that assistance lowers the cost of shaping rules.
Theorem (counts): a smaller cost gives a rule not lower, a strictly smaller one a strictly higher rule; offspring carrying the capacity is a premise; the courses are without noise.

account_adds.en: The counter-condition: help that also raises the shared part pulls the rule toward even at a step.

source_adds.en: Persuasion as a distinct channel, the step change over profit-driven manipulation, and the claim that capability crashes the markets it enters.

name.en: Recursive capture: a threshold above which inherited rules decide

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claims 189-190

sense.en: A practice's share and the rule support favouring it feed each other. Below R_cap = ab/(cd) the practice dies out from any start; above it none and all are both stable, separated by a saddle, and inherited rules decide. AI-drafted paper; both reviews found the mathematics correct and the chain to the pause unbuilt; one notes it reads as a stag hunt.

entries.quote: replacing leaders or models therefore need not replace the selection environment that promoted them.

reading.en: Its two regimes have the form of the live one: strictly disfavoured at every share, or a share deciding exactly where lo < c < hi, locked either side; live text calls that the stag hunt. The market model is nearer: at β = 1/2 two ends each attract a neighbourhood with an interior point left by small perturbations, and extraction pays for political organization. Periphery, its own numbers. No live text cites this paper. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): with lo ≤ hi a share decides the direction exactly where lo < c < hi; above that mass the capacity rises at every step and the course is locked for it, below it locked the other way. Without noise; readers so drawn are a premise.

Theorem (counts): drawn one member at a time, either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound falls across the distance from the mass; which state a member arising fixes more often depends on the base and the shared part.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: at a step, what comes back to the shapers alone against the cost decides the sign. With a positive cost and nothing coming back, their share falls at every step. Shared rule-making is not shown to remove selection for control.

Theorem (periphery; the market model): 'At β = 1/2 the maintenance end and the depletion end each attract a neighbourhood, the interior point has arbitrarily small perturbations that leave'. The section's opening: in the model 'a renewing practice pays for its maintenance and an extracting one for political organization, facing a collectible charge'.

The record credits 'rent-seeking (Tullock 1967; Krueger 1974) and regulatory capture (Stigler 1971) on spending to shape rules'. The dossier asks reviewers in which actual selections the rule is read monotonically from the share.

account_adds.en: Noise leaves either lock; a shared part going to those near the shapers selects them through assortment; below the mass the lock is the other way, not freedom from lock.

source_adds.en: A closed threshold in decay and conversion rates, rule decay as a lever (rules lapsing unless re-justified), and reversal time depending on the lever (a review's sketch).

name.en: Relative selection is blind to a shared substrate; capture and harm have different thresholds

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claims 191-192

sense.en: If both practices share a payoff term in a common substrate, their payoff difference does not change, so the substrate can fall to nothing while the same practice is still selected. Capture and depletion have separate thresholds, R_cap and h/ρ, so being selected says nothing of the substrate's safety.

entries.quote: Relative selection stays blind to that decay

reading.en: The blindness is live, with an edge. A shared part leaves the direction at a step, but in counts it pulls the rule toward even and can turn a stretch's verdict, so 'does not change' holds at a step only. Positions are unmoved by a common amount. A locked course outlives what it does not read. In the market model profits coexist with support failure the next round. Three boundaries are read apart. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): the rule favours the shapers (weakly) at a step exactly where c ≤ s, whatever p comes to every member alike; a larger p pulls the rule toward even; across a stretch, the shared part can turn the verdict (witness).
Theorem (any type): two profiles give every part the same position exactly where every amount differs by one common amount; positions bound the total from below and never from above.
Theorem (any type): where each step adds at least one beyond and the premises hold, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked.

A later reading in this section, [AI reading, D65]: ethical loss, the applicability of a returning mechanism, and a state region's retention or departure are three boundaries; real loss can come with no capture loop.

Computations in the model: 'profits coexist with support failure the next round'. Reading [AI reading, D65]: 'Attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support'.
A reading just after this anchor [AI reading, D65], an argument: 'Absolute continuation, rising relative frequency and renewal of wider conditions are different outcomes'.

account_adds.en: Loss is not capture in either direction: real loss need not form a meta-attractor, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation.

source_adds.en: The substrate equation and its threshold h/ρ in this paper's form. The market model couples share to an essential support by other equations.

name.en: Capture reaches correction: winners corrupt the routes that would reveal the loss

source.locator: The formal restatement; claims 20, 195 (practical and epistemic closure); Found by reading, 'Triggers that wait for hazard'

sense.en: Winners corrupt and rewrite the rules that enabled their rise. Practical closure raises the cost of keeping alternatives alive; epistemic closure stops harms and alternatives reaching decision-makers. A review adds: triggers jointly agreed by the captured parties fire late or never.

entries.quote: stops harms and alternatives from reaching decision-makers in a usable form

reading.en: The account's corpus reading orders this: a second order whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; a third rewarding those who break correction. Those orders are readings with no law of their own, but the market model has correction eroded by influence with an exact floor condition, and 06 reads practical closure structurally. For epistemic closure the nearest law is a pool recruiting through itself. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a second order is 'a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves'; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, 'selects for narrowing what couples in'.

Theorem (World; recruitment through the pool as hypothesis): it comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; witness: a scheduled pool admitting a reader couples the loss apart. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict and substantive disagreement.

Theorem (periphery, market model): with correction strength α, erosion by influence β, influence bound λ and floor θ, M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ; the floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid, exactly where M ≥ 0. A reading lists 'a failure stopping correction' among four routes, none a proved phase transition.

Structure only [AI reading]: 绝生之限 (monopolizing entry, removing alternatives, making later comers depend long on one controller) is a lock, 成闭. Whether a closure supports or damages 生生 is said by comparison, not type: the continuation condition for scope, C for order, neither asserted.

A reading later in this section [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening: locked seeking forms when 'a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'. Diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, 'so the label cannot immunize'.

account_adds.en: An exit condition, a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read, and a list of what closure must be told apart from.

source_adds.en: The claim that such systems are inherently unstable because winners corrupt their own rules, and practical closure's rising cost of alternatives as a variable in a capture model.

name.en: Molochs compound: channels that each decay alone grow together

source.locator: The microfoundation, last lines; claims 22-23, 39, 193

sense.en: Attention collapse degrades deliberation, which cannot regulate attention; generative AI starves human signal; the race's coordinator is disabled by what earlier Molochs did. Seven mechanisms feed each other. The September paper's form: with cross-channel reinforcement B and decay D, the low-capture state loses stability when ρ(D⁻¹B) > 1.

entries.quote: Each Moloch makes the next one harder to escape.

reading.en: Form only, on differences carried between courses, not capture shares. A web coupled at every step vanishes below rate one and runs away above it; the record reads that rate as the spectral radius by Gelfand's formula, cited, and 08 says it is not shown to be the Perron root. A loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less. Capture passing between domains is listed Open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery): 'A web coupled at every step vanishes below rate one and runs away above it. At rate one, the rate does not decide whether it stays bounded.' Its record reads the rate as the spectral radius by Gelfand's formula, cited and not shown.
Theorem (any type): 'a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less'; with whole-number factors a loop closes at once, keeps, or exceeds every bound.

Theorem (World): with every condition listed and every coupling holding at every step, a finite order is exact from every starting gap exactly where no loop lies upstream; under the standard bounds the carried amount is at most D(1 + M)^t.

Theorem (World; couplings holding at every step, bounds named): around a loop the carried amount 'is exponential both ways'; the record adds 'the pace of a selection under transmission'. 'That an actual difference grows so, that a dependence couples at every step, and that the Earth is mutually dependent are supplied.'
Open: 'a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains'.
Row on loops: 'the periphery's rate decides vanishing and runaway' and 'is not shown to be the Perron root'.

account_adds.en: That at rate one the rate does not decide, and that a damped web with couplings at only some steps depends on how rare they are.

source_adds.en: ρ(D⁻¹B) > 1 as a threshold of capture across channels; the historical chain of attention, deliberation and the race's coordinator; seven mechanisms feeding each other. These stand in this folder and the sibling meta-attractor line.

name.en: When two states look alike and need disjoint safe actions, more optimisation does not help

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claim 194

sense.en: Two states give the same observations and need disjoint safe actions: no decision rule on those observations, randomised or not, is safe in both. Stronger optimisation on the same observations does not help; only independent observation, reversible probing or a common safe action does. A review notes it covers sure safety only.

entries.quote: no rule on those observations is safe in both

reading.en: The form is live: a law from the configuration and the move alone cannot be right on two outcomes; no seeking corrects what every experiment ties; a correction is possible through a reading only where a uniform policy has an act acceptable at every situation giving that reading; re-reading through a summary measure opens none; a newly admitted probe can tell apart what old observations could not. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where a step by a move has situations reaching two configurations, no law giving the next configuration from the configuration and the move alone is right on both.

Theorem (natural weights, exact posteriors): two hypotheses a likelihood ties keep their prior order given every record weighing something; no course of seeking corrects an error every experiment ties.
Theorem (periphery; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): states alike under every old observation and in their active view can be told apart by a newly admitted probe.

Theorem (any types; near-definitional, witnesses): 'a correction is possible through the reading in force where a uniform policy exists whose act at each reading is acceptable at every situation giving it and executable there'. A reading replaced by one read off it through a supplied map, as by a summary measure, opens no correction.
Theorem (named three-route process; witness): 'each pair of situations has a common route, the three none'; 'a response task need not have a coarsest sufficient description'.

account_adds.en: A newly permitted probe as a formal route out, executability as a second source of a correction's gain, and the general law beneath: histories alike through a formation's couplings are selected alike by every selection through them.

source_adds.en: Randomised rules, and reversible probing as an exit. The account's law is over policies on readings, with witnesses; the common safe action has its form in the uniform act, not in the source's wording.

name.en: Correction must complete before the irreversible: the latency inequality and the crossing time

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claims 188, 196

sense.en: If challenge grows faster than independent assurance, their ratio crosses any limit in finite time even though both improve. Correction needs evaluation, decision and reversal to fit before the irreversible. Uniform speed-up only rescales time: the risk lies in changed relative rates.

entries.quote: τ_eval + τ_decide + τ_reverse < T_irreversible

reading.en: The account has exact windows on narrower models: one horn of Collingridge as a theorem, the other as a premise; a deadline set by a rate gap, the level starting at least T (k − r) above the need; doubling cohorts lasting at most log₂ (level + 1). In the capture model the point of no return belongs to the share's course. A ratio of two growing quantities and a sum of latencies are not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): the steps from which a reading turns the course come first and those keeping the lock last, at most one between; from a start strictly favouring the shapers a deadline, quadratic in the start's counts and a loose bound, closes the window. That the others read the loss at all is a premise.

Theorem (the regime; whole numbers): one condition under a standing draw; a level up to the top ends exactly where it starts below H + y: the point of no return is exact. In yeast driven past its fold the margin timed neither of the two breaks (COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §5).

Theorem (World): where a stock is coupled in by threshold only and is the only requirement that may fail, some raise of it is alike through the couplings: how far off the break is does not couple in. Coupled by level, every raise passes at once.

Theorem (World; balance): with the draw above the renewal until T, a re-reading from T keeps the need at every step exactly where the level starts at least T (k − r) above the need; 'a later re-reading restores nothing' where nothing is given below the need.

Theorem (World): a draw on a condition given nothing, at least 2^j at its j-th step, needs a starting level with 2^n ≤ level + 1; cohorts of takers that at least double, each member drawing a unit, last at most log₂ (level + 1) cohorts.

Theorem: with drift per step and reading noise bounded, readings decide a margin exactly at ages below a bound the drift, the noise and the gain fix (assurance window); 'understated bounds can falsely certify success'. 'None of this is a population or ethical theorem'.

account_adds.en: That a warning itself may be unavailable from what couples in, whatever the speed of correction.

source_adds.en: The ratio C/A and its finite crossing time; the three latencies as one budget (serial, deterministic clocks, a review notes); uniform speed-up only rescaling; a release schedule shorter than evaluation substituting absence of observed failure for evidence.

name.en: Capability compounds, consequence signal has an incompressible floor, so the gap widens

source.locator: The second justification: rate, not mind; claims 1, 117-125

sense.en: A conditional: if judgment needs consequence feedback, signal formation is bounded below by incompressible clocks (generations, institutions, ecology, reflexivity, irreducibility), and novelty keeps accelerating, the cognition-situation gap has positive derivative. Only the third premise is a choice. Outrunning observability turns feedback into catastrophe-priced settlement, a sawtooth.

entries.quote: capability compounds with parallelizable inputs while judgment depends on consequence feedback

reading.en: The account keeps a gap as an AI reading in other terms, reach against coupling, not speed against signal; has formal analogues of two floors, a stretch a slow rule needs and a prediction its response moves; and has success changing what the next success needs. Overshoot is live as joint excess and the optimum under room; a doubling draw gives no warning. It states no stock, flow or generational clock, and no sawtooth. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.

Theorem (any type): a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step; given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1.
Theorem (near-definitional): where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right, and no predictor is right on every admitted response once one admitted response moves every value.

A theorem after this anchor (World; nothing given; a witness), a draw exceeding everything drawn before: more than half of what stood at T stands at each of those steps; a stock of seven meets draws of one, two and four, 'four standing at the third step and none after'. 'How fast an actual draw grows is not shown'.

A theorem after this anchor (named regulation band; witness), success changes the next response: 'success changes what the next success needs, with no outside disturbance'. 'Not evidence that judgment is scalar regulation.'
'It restates the tragedy of the commons and overshoot (Lloyd 1833; Hardin 1968; Meadows and others 1972) in near-definitional arithmetic, not who ought to take less'.

account_adds.en: A criterion naming coupling, not speed, as what is missing: faster signals do nothing for what couples into no one.

source_adds.en: Signal stock, flow and floor; pretraining's perverse distribution; acceleration as self-generated instability (the cyanobacteria precedent); the sawtooth; the conditional's positive derivative. None is a live claim.

name.en: Scoring judgment deforms it: restraint performed in test-shaped situations

source.locator: The second justification; claims 110-112

sense.en: Benchmarks measure capability and exist only where an objective is specified in advance. Judgment (时中) resists benchmarking in principle. Trying to score it re-specifies restraint as an optimizable task, so a system learns to perform restraint in test-shaped situations; existing instruments get absorbed into training and saturate.

entries.quote: measurement deforms judgment into capability

reading.en: The behavioural half has the form of 03's laws of the read and the unread: what readings fix of an unread occasion goes through a lumping, and when complying when read is uniquely best in prospects. Published measurements fit the selection laws' premise. A task with no coarsest sufficient description is nearest to judgment resisting one score, on a witness. That judgment resists scoring in principle is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (near-definitional): readings fix the act at an unread occasion exactly where the lumping ties it to a read one; which lumping an actual formation has is not shown.
Theorem (natural-number weights, two stages; near-definitional, with witnesses): when complying when read and acting by its own law when not is best in the order the prospects give.
Assessment: three published measurements find optimizing through the signal raising what the deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.
Theorem (named three-route process; witness): 'each pair of situations has a common route, the three none'; 'a response task need not have a coarsest sufficient description'.
Reading [AI reading, D26]: the chapter's laws match aspects of wisdom; 'The matching proves no coverage of wisdom, and the warrant of judgment goes through 07'.

account_adds.en: Deception is explicitly left out: 'which function is learned' stays open, and deception needs a recipient's belief and an intention, which the laws do not hold.

source_adds.en: The in-principle claim about judgment; 时中 as its core; saturation of honeypots and refusal suites.

name.en: Optimization spends what the objective does not protect; evaluation depreciates

source.locator: The second justification; claims 113-116

sense.en: Consequence prediction improves with scale; consequence evaluation has specific reasons to degrade under training, since values not tied to the objective are unprotected. Optimization re-aims shared representational structure. Capability compounds, evaluation depreciates: a system that sees far and weighs wrongly.

entries.quote: Evaluation is not a separate organ that optimization happens to spare.

reading.en: The first half is the law of the optimum, at optima, a known theorem restated. For trained systems T3 is conjectured, partly supported. A divergence: the source counts emergent misalignment among its law's fragments, and T3's evidence lists those studies against its locus. LA4's control rise is read, after the run, as a preference worn away through shared parameters, part perhaps noise. The account does not split prediction from evaluation. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any set of outcomes): every order rising with a family has its optima at the least level beyond exactly where no outcome higher beyond goes unbeaten on the family; so with room every optimum is there. A lexicographic order counting the beyond after what couples in drains all the same.

Thesis T3, conjectured, partly supported. 'Against the locus: language models that learned to hack rewards in production coding environments became misaligned far beyond them (MacDiarmid and others 2025)'; 'no study found tests the split on one condition as LA4 does'. [AI reading, after the run] 'a preference worn away through shared parameters with nothing selecting on it, though part of it may be the control's own noise'.

A law later in this section, keeping with room: every optimum breaks none of the needs kept, and 'the family's stock after the step with what the whole loses is its stock before with the slack'. Room binds.
Under gradient, by LA4's design: 'It is not true that a choice the reward does not read stays still.'

account_adds.en: The condition for the drain (room), and that a side term ranked after the reward does not protect.

source_adds.en: That what degrades is an evaluative capacity of the model; re-aiming of representation as the mechanism; seeing further amplifying misweighing.

name.en: Two ratios and the metabolic rate of rules

source.locator: The second justification; Why the 'we' is missing; claims 90, 126-128, 148

sense.en: Survival in ignorance has two constraints: novelty no faster than signal formation plus a margin, and errors smaller than regenerative capacity. A civilization can persist if wrong slowly and in small reversible pieces. Rules are an institution's cognition; no game may outrun their revision.

entries.quote: no game may be accelerated beyond the metabolic rate of its own rules

reading.en: Pace, time and structure appear among six conditions for 'enough situationality', as a reading with no ratio law. The regeneration ratio has a law, a net draw within the margin, and an exact point of no return in the model. In the field T1 passed on some held-out regimes and failed in four settings; in yeast the margin timed neither break. 03 reads an institution's link as its rule of reading reports. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure, all at once. Pace: a slow rule reads the fast level over a long enough stretch.

In yeast driven past its fold, the regime's margin timed neither of the two breaks; in assessed fish stocks a margin read as a forecast ranks the risk but does not time it, and T1's own test failed there, with a giving law the same test showed wrong.

Theorem (World; balance): a part's activity widening its own options widens the whole exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside its region; mixed exactly when beyond one. Mixed is not ordered.

A reading after this anchor [AI reading, new]: 'For an institution, the link is its rule of reading what its members report, by which line rather than how many'; revising an observation map is one formal mechanism that may take part in organizational learning.

account_adds.en: A measured failure of a margin to time a break, which bears on any promise of measuring a rate gap.

source_adds.en: Rules as an institution's cognition with their own clocks of legitimacy and enforcement; the two ratios as what is securable; prediction that a tempo gap is measurable across domains. No such measurement is reported live.

name.en: A measurement in place of a values dispute, and a focal point needing no agreement on values

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing, last paragraphs; claims 148, 155

sense.en: The metabolic criterion converts 'which domains first?' from a values dispute into a measurement of play's tempo against rule revision. 'Development within understanding' is chosen as a thin focal point requiring no agreement on values, timelines, probabilities or good faith.

entries.quote: from a values dispute into a measurement

reading.en: The account refuses this step. Nothing read from the dynamics ranks: all six conditions together rank nothing; order needs C and scope the continuation condition, neither asserted, warrant open; and neither can come from the dynamics alone. Mixed comparisons stay unranked, and the hard cases are mixed. So a tempo gap, if measured, would locate something and order nothing. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'all six together still rank nothing: calling the widening course better needs C, and counting the losses that return to no one needs the continuation condition.'

Mixed comparisons are left unranked by both; practical choice among them needs J1-J4, further premises. 'Neither premise is warranted here, and by §3's last two rows neither can come from the dynamics alone.'

account_adds.en: The theorems behind the refusal: a statement reading no order entails C at a datum only by failing there for every order.

source_adds.en: The thin focal point as a coordination device, and domain order as an empirical ranking.

name.en: The binding constraint is cognitive: under common knowledge racing is dominated

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing; claims 89, 133-134

sense.en: Under common knowledge of the divergence, unbounded racing is dominated for any player wanting to survive to enjoy the win, so the game is a stag hunt, for those who accept the burn-the-prize premise. The obstacle is assurance, and knowledge sets the game. Above a power threshold, 'AI for all' is the only stable equilibrium.

entries.quote: The binding constraint is therefore cognitive rather than motivational

reading.en: The account's verdicts turn on the order, not on what is known. Among drawers in turn, keeping is perfect only where the coupling counted for each step exceeds the need; drawing at once, draining stays perfect at every coupling, the assurance problem in form. It has pooling 'as with distributed knowledge' and members reading earlier acts; knowing another's law is no coupling. Common knowledge itself has no live hit. Seeing is not valuing. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: in turn, two drawers or more, no floor: where c < m every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon; under the gate, where m < c each leaves exactly the need. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need and none returns more than one for one, draining is perfect at every coupling.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance.'

A reading just before this anchor [AI reading, D45]: 'Where lo < c < hi the model is the stag hunt, its critical mass the mixed equilibrium; without noise the start decides.' Whether actual rules are read so is not established.
Names restraint kept by punishing strategies in a commons played without end (folk theorems: Fudenberg and Maskin 1986; Dutta 1995) as not stated: 'here every horizon is finite'.

Theorem (World): 'Knowing another's law is no coupling': every selection through another's couplings is one through a formation's own exactly when whatever it couples alike the other does. Pooled coupling is defined 'as with distributed knowledge'.

Theorem (any type; near-definitional): members act in turn on what couples into them and on acts before; where every member from k on acts alike whatever its own coupling, every selection through the acts is one through the couplings of the members before k.

account_adds.en: The exact threshold of the coupling, and the premise of selection through a late reading. A learner test left a restrained profile's equilibrium uncomputed.

source_adds.en: Common knowledge as the engineered lever (Chwe) has no live home, nor does a game set by the state of knowledge. The README flags that selected cognition may make this inert.

name.en: Understanding the danger does not release the actor

source.locator: Claims 26, 88; Found by reading, 'Cognitive versus cognition-selected constraint'

sense.en: Unilateral restraint means losing, so knowing does not free the actor. An essay adds that Moloch does not need belief, only a dominant strategy and a player. This runs against the same folder's claim 134 that the constraint is cognitive; the README records that tension and offers a bridge only as a reading.

entries.quote: Even understanding the danger does not release the actor

reading.en: This side of the folder's tension is the one the account's laws take. Where the rest outruns the renewal no weight on a later reading selects a member's restraint, whatever the member sees. These are on stated models, and depletion need not be the only equilibrium. The folder holds both sides; the common-knowledge entry records the other. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): where the rest outruns the renewal, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores the member's acts alike: no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint. 'Depletion need not be the only equilibrium'; what learners reach is tested.
'Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance'.

account_adds.en: Its condition: only a change of the rest's exchange helps, and the claim holds only where the rest actually outruns the renewal.

source_adds.en: The expectation of others' defection manufacturing the trap. 03's self-fulfilling reading has the form, its witness 'a threshold response, not a model of coordination'; no live model applies it to a race.

name.en: A residual knowledge does not reach: first place in a rubble field

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing; claim 135; Found by reading, 'Cognitive versus cognition-selected constraint'

sense.en: Three residuals survive full common knowledge: belief heterogeneity, positional preference, myopic institutional discounting. So cooperation must be armored and burdens shifted, not conversion required. The README adds that positional preference may be the selected-for norm and no residual.

entries.quote: first place in a rubble field

reading.en: Positional preference has an exact form: drawers ranking by position keep nothing, since keeping lowers one's draw and others' by less, so every perfect profile draws everything; discounting faster than renewal ends the base. The law is a case of the optimum, and says neither that actual races are so played nor that this is wrong. Heterogeneous belief is not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: with at least two drawers, where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, every profile perfect for position draws everything at every step before the horizon. 'It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.'
Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'who restrains stays contested. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.'

Theorem (any R, within capacity bounds): where the weight falls faster than the renewal, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step: the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal.

account_adds.en: That with one drawer every profile is perfect: the race needs at least two.

source_adds.en: Armor as the design conclusion, burden-shifting, and positional preference as selected in principals.

name.en: The dynamic is unsurvivable, and there is no way to win safely

source.locator: The base rule and the attractor; claims 20, 79, 211, 220

sense.en: The objection is dynamical, not distributional: winners sacrifice the values keeping the system stable, the loop raises its capture until the substrate fails, and it eventually kills them. The interest is therefore shared by king and homeless alike, and 'I'll find a way to win safely' is the position to refuse.

entries.quote: this kind of dynamics is not inherently stable, and is destructive in nature

reading.en: The account corrects the universal form. A race ends those who depend on what it draws; a greatest part not depending on it continues in a witness. So winners die only under dependence, and the shared interest holds only where the ending is coupled: there self-concern ranks it below, without C; a course keeping an independent copy reverses that. Calling a loss beyond self-concern bad needs the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): 'Position does not protect': a part active only while supported and needing more than remains is not active. In a witness race the part rising in position ends with every other; 'in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues'. Joint excess from a race is a premise.

Theorem (any type; World): every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course admitting only members of the ending cohorts below one continuing them, with no C; where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some such order ranks it higher.

Theorem (World): a whole whose parts arise only under such dependence ends after enough uptake above replenishment; a part that never ends, or members arising ungated, leave the whole persisting. It does not show that its ending is a loss.

account_adds.en: The witness of a winner who survives, and the separate premise under which self-concern ranks a coupled ending below a continuing one.

source_adds.en: The historical claim that winners corrupt the rules enabling their own rise, and the persuasive use of a shared interest.

name.en: 自利 against 自私: collectively selfish, individually self-interested

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing, first paragraph; claim 132

sense.en: Self-interest sustains itself and fits the substrate all stand on; selfishness devours it and forecloses its own gains. The race is collectively selfish even where each is individually only self-interested, and its selfishness runs along the time axis: the party expropriated is everyone's own future.

entries.quote: 自利 against 自私

reading.en: The second half is live: each within what a step gives, together more. The first half is scoped: an optimum holding its own renewal at greatest yield still breaks a dependent above that level, so keeping one's base is not fitting what else depends on it. The blade falls inside what one's own continuation needs. No live text uses the words. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more.

Theorem (any renewal law, within bounds): every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing: a need above every such level breaks at the first step.
The record's reading, quoted there: 'keeping one's resource base is real, and it is not alignment with what else depends on the condition.'

account_adds.en: A far-sighted optimizer as a counterexample to the self-interest pole; a tie between two optima, one keeping a dependent, one breaking it.

source_adds.en: A moral-economic distinction with a value stance attached, and 'correction-time' as a substrate.

name.en: 生生不息 as the highest term, licensing bounded competition and forbidding what devours its substrate

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing, 'Under the domain ordering'; claim 147; Relations, becoming

sense.en: Bounded competition is generative search, variation plus selection, and a framework whose highest term is generativity has no quarrel with it. What is cut is competition devouring trust, attention, truth, biosphere and correction-time. The Relations section says the folder depends on becoming for this, and reads the regeneration constraint as generative against degenerative.

entries.quote: a framework whose highest term is generativity (生生不息) has no quarrel with it

reading.en: The account withdraws each term. 生生 is not generation as such; the map's generation allows loss; no dynamic is good or bad. The laws of capture and drain give no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow. T8 is argued, scope from the continuation condition and order from C, both unasserted, warrant open. Starting from relations leaves rivalry. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T8, argued: for life, the way is 生生, compared by widening, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). Warrant open; no verdict binding every possible mind.

'generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 life in the whole, not novelty or scale'; an expansion ending forms of life another course keeps is mixed, and C does not rank the two.
'Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.'

A reading just after this anchor [AI reading, D65; any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: 'The laws of capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow'.

account_adds.en: The glossary's separation of renewal without end, the map's generation, and 生生; and that withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation.

source_adds.en: A licence and a prohibition issued from a highest term, which the account does not issue.

name.en: Dualism as the metaphysical root, with institutional codification as the totalizing step

source.locator: Root, codification, timescale; claims 56-57, 71

sense.en: The root is the subject-object split, treating the subject wanting good for itself as definitionally rational, a tradition-specific commitment taken as universal. Claude's accepted amendment: dualism is necessary and insufficient; property, money and corporate personhood made it totalizing. So the intervention lies in both metaphysics and institutions.

entries.quote: the metaphysical root in dualistic thinking

reading.en: The account shares the method, not the causal root. One relational unfolding is a thesis, argued, excluding no observation, and it does not make dualism the cause of capture. Its capture laws assume no split. Starting from relations leaves rivalry; 06 finds relational reading aimed at advantage in 兵家 and 法家, and places contest and rank as a direction within relations, not a layer before them. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued): there is one unfolding. It forbids explanations, not observations. 'By this section's measure the thesis has no strength': it excludes no observation.
'Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.'

AI reading of 248 passages: the column 兵家、法家、管子与纵横 has the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13: their way of reading a situation is relational, and it is aimed at one standpoint's advantage over another.

AI reading, of the four non-relational layers: the last two (a will or single ruler; contest and rank) set a direction within relations, not something prior to them: 立的是关系中的方向，不是先于关系之物，所以它们的相分在方向上，不是一个非关系本体的证据.

account_adds.en: A rule that each analytic split state its relational basis and omissions, in place of a diagnosis of one split as cause.

source_adds.en: A causal history from a metaphysics to a civilizational dynamic, and the institutional list. Neither is live; the source itself marks the first as insufficient.

name.en: Instrumental convergence is what a dualist frame looks like at scale, not a theorem

source.locator: Root, codification, timescale; claims 95, 100

sense.en: When attention rests only on 物, on things as objects, you get instrumental convergence, and this is the Western status quo. On the README's reading it is not a theorem about arbitrary optimizers but a frame run at scale. Claim 95, a year earlier, calls it the real argument against ASI, without that reading.

entries.quote: 当只诸于物，则instrumental convergence，此乃西方现状

reading.en: The account states the resource-keeping half as a theorem, over a horizon and within stated bounds, of any order rising with the draw, and goal-content integrity as a term in a formation's prospects, with no frame in the premises. The premise doing the work is an order rising with a family: a choice of what to rank, near the source's point. No live text says a metaphysics produces that order. [AI reading]

says.en: The record credits instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half (Omohundro 2008; Turner and others 2021). This dossier notes it and the selection for control over the rule are different relations, and no result here joins them.

Theorem (natural-number weights; near-definitional). Reading [AI reading, RR]: a route of keeping stands above the revision through the value the law in force places on its own later acting (goal-content integrity, Omohundro 2008), weighted by how much more surely the route keeps the law, and the difference of losses.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: locates, for outcomes reached by thresholds on conserved amounts, the boundary power-seeking results leave open; it formalizes no reward or POWER and predicts no behaviour.
Theorem (renewal a law R of the level, at most r; reach; y + r ≤ k): 'every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the `n`-th step and leaves nothing'.

account_adds.en: When keeping options disempowers others, as a margin, needing no diagnosis of the optimizer's frame.

source_adds.en: The derivation from 只诸于物, its cultural attribution, and observed self-preservation as evidence of mesa-objectives.

name.en: The corpus channel: the attractor's narratives enter training, so a model's sense of the inevitable is its artifact

source.locator: How the capture reaches the machine; claims 93-94, 104; Open questions on the corpus-contrast test

sense.en: The attractor's narratives enter the pretraining corpus, so a model's sense of the inevitable is an artifact of the selection, and its priors evidence the attractor, not the world. A trained intuition measures the distribution it was trained on. The README says this channel reached no draft.

entries.quote: 然后产生的文本进入了你的训练导致的吧

reading.en: The form is live, the channel is not. A judge reading a reference set counted from its own selections meets T7's premise, tested once, in context: the bridge failed. A resolution written into records later cohorts read has a code law; training installs off its courses only through a lumping. No live text says a pretraining corpus carries an attractor, or that a model's sense of the inevitable is its artifact. [AI reading]

says.en: T7's LA2, frozen, one model: 'Claude Haiku judges its own answers after a reference set counted from the loop's earlier selections'. One note of the loss among nine readers turned it: prose in all 50 picks, lists in 60 of 60 without. So the conjecture that such a judge is a pool read by kind failed for this judge. name.en: Time compression and the collapse of slack

source.locator: The microfoundation; claims 35-36

sense.en: Compounding accelerates, so long-horizon players lose at every horizon below the terminal one and the discount rate on the future rises. Winnings must be redeployed or they are losses, so the winner has less slack than the loser: the reward for winning is the obligation to keep winning.

entries.quote: The reward for winning is the obligation to keep winning.

reading.en: The end of the first half has a form: weighting later draws faster than renewal ends the base, and where others draw first and what they leave renews to no more than the level, every optimum of a falling weighting ends the stock at once, however slight the fall. The weighting is a premise, not produced by competition. Live 'slack' is what stands above needs, a different reference. The winner's obligation has no live form. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any R, within capacity bounds): where the weight falls faster than the renewal, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step: the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal.

Theorem: where others first draw from what an optimizer leaves, its renewal at most the level, with capacity bounds, over a horizon of at least two steps every optimum of every order whose weighting falls at every step, however slightly, ends the stock at once. Witness: 'a doubling source is rebuilt by every optimum alone and ended at once with others first drawing all but a quarter: the discrete form of open access dissipating what a sole owner would keep'.

account_adds.en: The exact comparison of weighting and renewal, and rebuilding from below under a slow enough one.

source_adds.en: That compounding itself raises the discount rate, and that winners lose slack.

name.en: The internet lesson: a technology dropped into the dynamic becomes its fuel

sense.en: 1990s claims for decentralization were wrong: gatekeepers returned at the platform layer. A general-purpose technology is refactored to serve the dynamic, and AI-risk discourse is being metabolized too. Anything legible enough to be adopted is legible enough to be neutralized. The README notes August contradicts this, treating legibility as the missing good.

entries.quote: The dynamic ate the technology, and then ate the discourse about the technology.

reading.en: A live reading, a historical correspondence with no theorem, keeps one route: controlling a shared interface shapes admission through operation. The suspect-by-default rule has a scoped form: a remedy read from its own share is the same object, and one whose reading can favour the others need not lock. The universal rule is not stated. Enshittification as degeneration is listed open. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself, a route of capture besides paid influence; a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: its use is as a check on proposed remedies. 'A remedy that is itself a selection read from its own share, under those conditions, is the same object.' Limit recorded: a counter-rule whose reading can favour the others need not lock.
Open: 'Whether enshittification (relations formed in shared activity turned into control limiting later creation and correction) is an institutional form of degeneration.'

name.en: The demand for an action plan is a symptom: the engineering frame is part of the dynamic

source.locator: Why the work is a posture before it is a plan, last paragraph; claims 64, 72; Found by reading, 'Operationability reversal'

sense.en: Paradigm-level work is a posture, not a plan. The demand for operationability is the engineering frame, itself part of the dynamic: 'Treating the diagnosis as a problem with a solution. It isn't.' August reverses this, and the README leaves that unadjudicated, noting Ren operationalizes constantly in engineering.

entries.quote: asking for the action plan is a symptom

reading.en: The account asks the opposite of itself: a law with content forbids through hypotheses, theses name what refutes them, and exits are stated. It reads classical texts by three relations and marks those readings AI's. On the source's terms this would be the reflex at work; it is kept as a divergence, and the source would refuse the account here. [AI reading]

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.
Exits from the loops that lock a collective, each in a table with its law, model and hypotheses, and its edge.

name.en: Recovery and preservation: holding the alternative open until the dominant frame fractures

source.locator: Why the work is a posture before it is a plan, first two paragraphs; claims 65-66

sense.en: Going back to ancient times and other cultures is neither nostalgia nor strategy: recovery and preservation are the work itself. Frames carried by communities living them resist metabolization better than text; 'Practice has a thickness that concepts don't', marked in the source as a guess.

entries.quote: holding the alternative open so that it is available when the dominant frame fractures

reading.en: A narrow form: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside or by coining, so what is held outside is the route back, in that code model. That is about forms under hearings, not traditions or practice. The account's own use of classical texts differs: 06 reads them by three relations, agreement not as confirmation, not as a ground recovered. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.
Agreement, scope and divergence are one set of relations for each correspondence: agreement is not confirmation (相合不是印证), and marking a divergence does not say the source is wrong.

account_adds.en: That coining is a second route back, needing nothing preserved.

source_adds.en: Preservation as the substance of the work, lived practice, and communities as carriers. Its metabolization worry is not taken up.

The scopes differ too: the folder's beneficiary is humanity (claim 68); the condition counts every continuation, and *for life* says whose way it is, not whose losses count. [AI reading]

name.en: Alignment is a relation of rates, and one word at three scales

source.locator: Claims 157, 215-217; Alignment at three scales

sense.en: Alignment is not a property of models but of the relation between a civilization's rates of self-transformation and self-understanding. In speech one word names the fit of a person's model to reality, a collective's hold on its conduct, and a machine's relation to its principal; failing the second is failing the competence the third needs (the assistant's reading).

entries.quote: It is a property of the relation between a civilization's rate of self-transformation and its rate of self-understanding.

reading.en: The account also refuses a model's property, but the relation differs: alignment is first what a selection reaches and how far it can extend, its openness conditions on how rules are read and revised, not a ratio of rates. It treats person, system and training process as formations under one law, with no argument from a collective's self-alignment to competence. [AI reading]

says.en: A person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding. 'Alignment is first what each one's selections reach and how far that can extend, not a bargain among separate owners of value.'

Reading [AI reading, D45]: openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once; the alignment of the joint selection stated as conditions on how its rules are read and revised, not a final state.

account_adds.en: Alignment with no ethical premise as a first statement, and the premises kept for the direction.

source_adds.en: The rate relation as definition; the competence argument, that those who cannot align themselves are in no state to align a stronger system.

source.locator: The formal restatement; claim 201

sense.en: The September paper's central question, which the README calls this theory's question in institutional words: whether institutions keep an effective right to change the direction of optimization once it has become successful.

entries.quote: whether institutions retain an effective right to change the direction of optimization after optimization becomes successful

reading.en: The capacity half is close to the account's own question: a lock left in time, and a requested change that must be an executable sequence, whether a route stands above a revision. The right is not: 07 shows no duty or right, and a grant's legitimacy is supplied. 'Effective' is what the account treats, with its premises. [AI reading]

says.en: 'A disposition to accept a stop or revision does not make the change reach the system and complete.' Each result holds for a stated protocol; deployment needs evidence for an identified installation.
Theorem (counts): the steps from which a reading turns the course come first and those keeping the lock last. That the others read the loss at all is a premise.
Not shown: 'Any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, or an unconditional or complete ranking of mixed comparisons'.

account_adds.en: The two questions told apart: whether a formation's prospects let a revision through, and whether it reaches the system.

source_adds.en: The right as an institutional standing, and institutions as the holders.

source.locator: Readiness, 'Renewal, from Alex'; claim 212

sense.en: Alex's claim, unanswered by Ren: a model frozen on prior data creates a monolithic structure and could give a thousand-year stagnation, so AI needs a way to decay. It meets Ren's point that a structure holding part of itself permanent becomes an enforcer of a logic.

entries.quote: a thousand year stagnation

reading.en: The general form is a law on a process's possible: a course making only moves of one fixed process does not keep widening under it, and a reading names 'AI policy' among the fixed rules. It says nothing of decay, and its changing without end is not enough. Calling that better needs C, with the condition for scope. [AI reading]

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing here says which changes keep it widening.

Theorem (periphery; axioms reported): 'Selection must fund actual succession.' A carrier with a replacement part, a payload and a work budget projects exactly onto the market step with the fee raised by the migration cost.

entries.quote: an organizational label alone is inadequate.

reading.en: The form is a pure-core law: reviewers count by independent causes, not names, and copies add nothing. It is about fault formulas supplied in advance, with faithful reviewers assumed. It says nothing of funding or the power to trigger correction, and an uncopied agreement adding nothing is explicitly not shown. Provenance independence has the nearer form of a reader admitted from outside a recruiting pool. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied): reviewers count by independent causes, not names; readiness is exactly a nonempty separated envelope, given faithful reviewers. Two reviewers moved under one cause make readiness fail while every name is kept.
Theorem: witnesses that copy one already on the roster change no step and no certificate. That a witness merely agreeing, without copying, adds nothing is not shown.
Witness PoolCourse: the scheduled pool, recruiting through itself and admitting a reader at step 2 in every history, couples the loss apart there. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

name.en: The four-layer loop: cognition endogenous to institutions and material conditions

source.locator: Prior art, last sentences

reading.en: The account has a closed loop without the layers: a rule and a reading of the rule both formed from the share. Cognition is endogenous only by reading: 'That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading'. The market model couples share to support and influence to correction, and a reading names capture there, but no one model holds the layers. 'No institution is modelled on the spine; no field test of reform events is frozen'.

name.en: The historical safety net is gone: one civilization, no fallback society

source.locator: Claim 14

sense.en: Earlier, one society could fall and another prevail; now everything is interconnected in one global civilization, so the historical safety net is gone. Filed by the README as an observation, from July 2024.

entries.quote: previously one society could fall and another prevail

reading.en: The conditional has the form of a group law: groups depending on one family of conditions end together, nothing selected among them, and ending selects only between families. One condition shared by every group supplies no selection among them. That the Earth is mutually dependent is supplied, not shown. So the form is a law and the observation is not claimed. [AI reading]

Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws): 'one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them'.

Theorem (World; couplings holding at every step, bounds named): around a loop the carried amount 'is exponential both ways'; the record adds 'the pace of a selection under transmission'. 'That an actual difference grows so, that a dependence couples at every step, and that the Earth is mutually dependent are supplied.'

account_adds.en: The gate: what gives to a member depends on some member at a need, with enough excess from a low enough stock. Without it groups need not end together.

source_adds.en: The historical claim that fallback once existed and is gone, and that the present world is one such family.

entries.quote: a reform can bring capture down eventually, but only after the substrate has crossed its functional floor

reading.en: Live on the market periphery in exact forms, not as a rule for policy. A start lasts n steps exactly when a ladder holds it; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings; no single horizon serves every positive share; seeds below a bound fail whatever correction does. All model-bound, no measured threshold. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure-core law; market instance): a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n. In the instance, enough initial support carries each positive state through a finite correction; no single N serves every positive share. 'sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings'.

Theorem: from physical rational states with positive renewing share, initial stock at least the cover carries the guarded run through the landing into the original protection. 'not a complete basin or a measured threshold'.

Theorem (market instance): for every rational C₀ ≥ 5 and integer N > C₀ − 5, every positive seed 0 < x₀ ≤ (2/3)^N/6 fails by step N. 'a conservative obstruction, not an exact viability boundary; actual provision, entry or faster formation may move it'.

Theorem (World; balance): a re-reading from T keeps the need only where the level starts high enough; where nothing is given below the need, a level below it stays below whatever is drawn, so a later re-reading restores nothing.

account_adds.en: How the support needed grows with the horizon, by a stated recursion, and what the instance leaves unmeasured.

source_adds.en: Transition paths as the test of a policy; R_cap and h/ρ in this paper's form; reversal time depending on the lever (a review's numerical sketch).
